title: Let me finish — overlapping native dialogue trial

clips.source_text:
Alex: I was trying to tell you why I left early but you wouldn't let me finish.
Sam (overlapping Alex): I know, I was there!
Sam: Because you keep saying nobody told you when I called you twice.
Alex (overlapping Sam): That's not what I said!

turns.speaker: Alex
turns.text: I was trying to tell you |I know,| why I left early |I was there!| but you wouldn't let me finish.
turns.style: Frustrated, speaking insistently at a brisk pace, continuing through the listener’s interruptions without yielding the floor.

turns.speaker: Sam
turns.text: Because you keep saying |That's not| nobody told you |what I said!| when I called you twice.
turns.style: Defensive and quick, talking over the listener’s protest and continuing the sentence without waiting.
